Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.morge.label: On the Unfinished Lark
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.morge.startdescription: 'You heard the news about Zidane, no? So sad. But happily, his work remains intact. I would see it completed. And so I come to learn…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=sky> as their <sprite name=sky> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.morge.label: On the Threshold Revolution
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.morge.startdescription: 'My particular interests are engaged here… you know? I don't know exactly. But I will.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=grail> as their <sprite name=grail> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.olymp.label: On the Oriflamme Heist
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.olymp.startdescription: 'I don't pretend to be any kind of expert. But some of the details about their safeguards seem curious. I'm hoping your collection will help me look into that.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=forge> as their <sprite name=forge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.olymp.label: On the Dappled Rose
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.olymp.startdescription: 'There is a tale that the Vagabond planted a black and white garden in Miah, before the curse, where the Moth would come at night. There are always tales…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moth> as their <sprite name=moth> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.olymp.label: On the 'Invisible Opera'
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.olymp.startdescription: 'My friend knows the stories of the ruin the Opera brings, and still he is determined. Well, if I cannot dissuade him, perhaps I can help him. I hope that something in your collection might help him find a way…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moth> as their <sprite name=moth> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.olymp.label: On the Unfinished Lark
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.olymp.startdescription: 'The government will sell that wonderful piece of Zuthi's for scrap. I know it. But I have a collector in mind - a very wealthy woman. I hope to convince her to invest in it. But I need to understand better the properties of the work…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=forge> as their <sprite name=forge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.olymp.label: On the Royal Endeavour
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.olymp.startdescription: 'No, I am no believer. But my mother, she believed; and she used to talk of the Second Dawn. Of course I did not take it seriously. But now the King's project. So strange. I would like to see what I can find in your collection...' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=forge> as their <sprite name=forge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.rowen.label: On the Sanctuary Draught
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.rowen.startdescription: 'There are dear memories here. I fear they will fade before I do. I am too close to eternity. Give me reminders, Librarian; diversions; indicators of blood…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=grail> as their <sprite name=grail> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.rowen.label: On the Feasting Few
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.rowen.startdescription: 'If I were here, I would acknowledge my crimes. I would ask you to set before me something to remind me why I had chosen to commit them.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=grail> as their <sprite name=grail> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.rowen.label: On the Softer Frost
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.rowen.startdescription: 'Recall to me, Librarian, the endingess of things.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=winter> as their <sprite name=winter> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.rowen.label: On Knot and Tangle
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.rowen.startdescription: 'She's misunderstood, the Grail, more than any other Hour. Without her, the drift to Eternity would never have lasted this long… show me, something, Librarian, to make that drift a little longer.' [[Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=grail> as their <sprite name=grail> Interest.]]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.seren.label: On the Oriflamme Heist
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.seren.startdescription: 'My suspicion, candidly, is that Oriflamme's has invented and spread the story. I can't fathom why. I need to look into the provenance and manufacture of some of these so-called 'fakes'.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=forge> as their <sprite name=forge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.seren.label: On the Particular Mystique
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.seren.startdescription: 'These manias have happened before, you know - these enthusiasms. In the Wars of the Roads, the Worm Wars, the Intercalate… I wonder how many features they share with the cults of other times?' [Try a book with as much Mystery:  <sprite name=lantern> as their <sprite name=lantern> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.seren.label: On the Unfettered Eye
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.seren.startdescription: 'I've known adepts who don't believe the Watchman has any Names at all - besides Sunset Celia, of course. They're wrong. But it can be very difficult to distinguish the Names from the Hour itself in this case. I'll need to read up.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=lantern> as their <sprite name=lantern> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.seren.label: On the Unfinished Lark
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.seren.startdescription: 'He was already making use of some very unusual alloys - very unusual techniques. I'd like to use the collection to develop some theories further…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=forge> as their <sprite name=forge> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.seren.label: On the Royal Endeavour
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.seren.startdescription: 'I hope I might find something in the collection here to allay my concerns. Or to crystallise them.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=forge> or Mystery: <sprite name=lantern> as their matching Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.stani.label: On the Grunewald Provision
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.stani.startdescription: 'An old acquaintance of mine at the Grove of Green Immortals would be very grateful for this… restless waxwork. But if I'm going to transport it all the way across Asia, I need to make sure it stays in its box.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> as their <sprite name=heart> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.stani.label: On the God in the Wood
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.stani.startdescription: 'I'd like to understand: why there? And I'd also like to understand: why now?' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> or Mystery: <sprite name=nectar> as their matching Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.stani.label: On the Sandalwood Saint
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.stani.startdescription: 'No, Librarian, my order - what's left of it! - is not recognised by the Church. But persons of good sense on either side of the doctrinal divide know how to keep communications open… sorry, every time it gets ecumenical I find myself talking like this. I know someone who knows a more important someone.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=nectar> as their <sprite name=nectar> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.stani.label: On the Friar's Tapestry
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.stani.startdescription: 'The Green Sages have long been interested in these doctrines, and the Haustorium has long been disinclined to share. The Sages are concerned that this might be a Haustorium trap. I suspect they're being overly cautious; but I have learnt, over the years, to take their instincts seriously.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=nectar> as their <sprite name=nectar> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.stani.label: On the Open Reverend
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.stani.startdescription: 'I am a gardener before I am a priest, and a priest before I am a healer. I know my limits. Perhaps you can help.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=heart> as their <sprite name=heart> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.yvett.label: On the Messenger's Casket
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.yvett.startdescription: 'St Columba of the Dove. There is a story that his coffin is here at Brancrug - one of the treasures of the House. Don't worry, I'm not going to ask about that. I respect the House's secrets. But I would like to know more about why he might have been brought here…' [Try a book with as much Mystery: as their Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.yvett.label: On the Grunewald Provision
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.yvett.startdescription: 'I'm still hoping it'll be safe to set the device in motion. But I'd like to be absolutely certain.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=winter> as their <sprite name=winter> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.yvett.label: On the Endless Guest
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.yvett.startdescription: 'He is Worm-inhabited, they say. I only half-understand what that means. I rather fear the Bureau doesn't either. I don't expect to be able to help him, or them; honestly, I want chiefly to assure my own safety.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=winter> as their <sprite name=winter> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.yvett.label: On the Forgivable Debt
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.yvett.startdescription: 'I've been looking into family history - again - and I can't make the records line up. I don't know exactly what I'm looking for, but I hope I'll find it here.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.yvett.label: On the Particular Mystique
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.yvett.startdescription: 'They've made up their minds I'm their appointed leader. I've made up my mind I'm not, but they're pretty insistent. They've got a bee in their bonnet about my family folklore...' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=winter> as their <sprite name=winter> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.yvett.label: On the Rising While
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.yvett.startdescription: 'I've been dreaming of a desert temple in moonlight… I don't think I want to tell you the rest. Not even by day. I'm sorry. May I see the collection?' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.yvett.label: On the Friar's Tapestry
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.yvett.startdescription: 'The best outcome, Librarian, seems to be that the rite involves the Hour named Applebright. The worst, that it involves the Crowned Growth. And both of these are Nowhere Hours. No one has ever been prepared to tell me what that really means, but I know enough not to roll around in it.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=moon> as their <sprite name=moon> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.yvett.label: On the Open Reverend
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.yvett.startdescription: 'I'm a novice in these matters - but I am coming to realise that most of us are novices most of the time. So I hope you have something suitable in your collection.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=winter> as their <sprite name=winter> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.zacha.label: On the Messenger's Casket
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.zacha.startdescription: 'I know the key. I only need its name.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=knock> as their <sprite name=knock> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.zacha.label: On the Grunewald Provision
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.zacha.startdescription: 'Some of it might have been clarities. Ovitic forms. Conducive. Could have been. I need to understand what.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=winter> as their <sprite name=winter> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.zacha.label: On the Oriflamme Heist
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.zacha.startdescription: 'I can almost see what happened. What really, really happened. I just need a little more.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=knock> as their <sprite name=knock> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.zacha.label: On the Endless Guest
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.zacha.startdescription: 'There's always out, and there's always down.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=knock> or Mystery: <sprite name=winter> as their matching Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.zacha.label: On the Particular Mystique
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.zacha.startdescription: 'If I find how they're going to end… I can offer them that.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=winter> as their <sprite name=winter> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.zacha.label: On the Open Reverend
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.failure.zacha.startdescription: 'The priest has received the grace of gates. I will learn here what may pass through that gate.' [Try a book with as much Mystery: <sprite name=winter> as their <sprite name=winter> Interest.]

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.agdis.label: On the Grunewald Provision
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.agdis.startdescription: 'Thank you, my friend. My worry now is that if this protection is sufficient, he will decide not to dispose of the thing at all - he will hope to keep it. And against Nowhere, the best protection is fleeting. I will use all my persuasions! Thank you!'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.agdis.label: On the Claw and the Clouds
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.agdis.startdescription: 'Change, Librarian. We who dedicate ourselves to Marsyas, to the dance that does not end - we have a contradictory relationship with change. If I go West, I am promised that I will become something more… but I will not; I am happy with what I am; almost happy.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.agdis.label: On 'Apollo and Marsyas'
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.agdis.startdescription: 'I knew that I would not regret coming here. And not only for the knowledge you have shared… I could grow to love this place, Librarian, even at its greyest. Perhaps I am coming to understand why you have set aside the world, and made Brancrug your home.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.agdis.label: On the God in the Wood
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.agdis.startdescription: 'I had read that honey is a part of the diet they offer in this place. I think now I understand the significance of this. Perhaps I will try it myself! Thank you, Librarian.'

Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.agdis.label: On the Unfinished Lark
Data:Talk.visitor.incident.success.agdis.startdescription: 'I think this will suffice. At least, I may not disgrace myself!'
